dataQuality.message: Dials, connects and talk time are read live from GHL call records (setters dial from the CRM) covering the last 45 days, so the Today/7d/30d/MTD/QTD windows are exact; YTD and All only include calls from the last 45 days. GHL reports a null duration on some completed calls, so talk time is a floor, not an exact total.
380 contacts are stuck carrying the sid-dial-1 toggle tag, which means dial pairs are not completing and attempt counts are not incrementing correctly. Check WF-2 before trusting attempt numbers.

Sophia and Heart have no matching GHL user account, so their outbound calls cannot be attributed and their Dials / Connects / Talk Time show a dash (only their Intro Call Form activity is counted). Give them GHL user logins to dial under for full per-setter call attribution.
